item.title: [6.8] Gold set for weekly gain as markets await US payrolls data
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Gold prices have seen a surge in early Asian markets, climbing by 0.4% as investors brace for the crucial US non-farm payrolls report. With a projected weekly increase of 5.9%, market sentiment remains optimistic. Two Federal Reserve officials have floated the idea of gradual interest rate hikes to tackle inflation.

WHY IT MATTERS

item.title: [6.8] Dollar holds, yen gains as equity rout saps risk appetite ahead of payrolls
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The dollar maintained its ground against key currencies as traders flocked to safe havens following a volatile market downturn. Concerns mounted over a potential Democratic majority in Congress, raising alarms about stricter regulations on the artificial intelligence sector. Meanwhile, the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds declined, signaling shifts in Federal Reserve interest rate outlooks.

WHY IT MATTERS
